items.summary: Williams Companies filed a prospectus supplement on November 2, 2026, covering the resale of up to 26,874,496 shares of its common stock by selling securityholders under the Securities Act of 1933. The filing includes a legal opinion from Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP regarding the validity of the shares.
items.title: Williams Companies files prospectus supplement for resale of 26.9 million shares

items.summary: HCA Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of HCA Healthcare, announced a proposed public offering of senior unsecured notes on November 2, 2026. The company intends to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include redemption of $1.2B of 4.500% senior notes due February 2027, repayment of borrowings under its $8.0B commercial paper program, and repayment of outstanding borrowings under its senior unsecured credit facility. The offering is subject to market conditions and actual terms will depend on pricing at the time of issuance.
items.title: HCA Healthcare subsidiary announces proposed senior notes offering

items.summary: Blackstone completed an offering of $600 million of 5.650% senior notes due 2031 and $500 million of 5.900% senior notes due 2033. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Blackstone Inc. and certain indirect subsidiaries. Blackstone said it intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes.
items.title: Blackstone completes $1.1B senior notes offering

items.summary: Procter & Gamble closed an underwritten public offering of $352.2M in aggregate principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due November 2, 2076 on November 2, 2026. The notes were issued under the company's Form S-3 registration statement.
items.title: Procter & Gamble closes $352M offering of 50-year floating rate notes

items.summary: Apple posted fourth fiscal quarter revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year, with iPhone and Services reaching record levels. Diluted earnings per share was $2.10, up 14 percent year over year, and full-year revenue reached $478.8 billion, also a record.
items.title: Apple reports record September quarter revenue of $114.5 billion

items.summary: Keysight Technologies appointed Jason Kary as Chief Financial Officer effective December 18, 2026, succeeding Neil Dougherty who served in the role for 13 years. Kary, age 58, has been Senior Vice President and President of the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group since November 2024 and previously served as Vice President, Treasurer and Investor Relations from December 2013 to November 2024. Dougherty is stepping down for personal reasons and will provide transition services through the end of fiscal year 2027.
items.title: Keysight appoints Jason Kary as Chief Financial Officer

items.summary: Intuitive Surgical appointed Aaron Martin, President of Insurance at Humana, to its board of directors effective January 1, 2027, expanding the board from 10 to 11 members. Martin will receive an annual cash retainer of $70,000 and an initial grant of restricted stock units worth $93,333. The board determined Martin is an independent director under Nasdaq and SEC rules.
items.title: Intuitive Surgical appoints Aaron Martin to board of directors

items.summary: Digital Realty Trust acquired approximately 16% of the interests in its Teraco joint venture on October 19, 2026, following a put right exercised by third party partners. The company issued common stock as consideration and is registering the resale of those shares pursuant to a prospectus supplement filed with the SEC.
items.title: Digital Realty Trust acquires 16% stake in Teraco joint venture

items.summary: Ingersoll Rand promoted Scott Watson to senior vice president and group president of Industrial Technologies and Services North America and EMEIA, and Shaun Carlson to senior vice president and group president of Precision and Science Technologies. Michael Weatherred, senior vice president of the Precision and Science Technologies segment, will retire effective immediately and serve in an advisory role through May 2028. The Board approved a new employment agreement with CEO Vicente Reynal and a new performance-based equity award of 226,098 PSUs valued at approximately $17.1 million.
items.title: Ingersoll Rand promotes Watson and Carlson to group president roles

items.summary: Xcel Energy Inc. signed an equity distribution agreement on October 30, 2026 allowing it to offer and sell up to $6 billion of common stock through 21 sales agents and forward purchasers. The new agreement replaces a prior $6 billion program from May 2026, under which $448.6 million remained unsold and $3.8 billion in forward sale agreements remain outstanding. Additionally, $2.2 billion in forward sale agreements from an August 2025 program remain outstanding.
items.title: Xcel Energy enters $6 billion equity distribution agreement with 21 banks
